headline: Christine Lagarde to Step Down as ECB President in February 2027
summary: The European Central Bank announced that President Christine Lagarde will resign on February 7, 2027, nine months before her term was scheduled to end.
why: The leadership of the ECB is central to the monetary policy direction of the eurozone, and changes in leadership can signal shifts in policy priorities.
why_moved: Unexpected leadership changes at major central banks create uncertainty, which is typically reflected in currency and bond market volatility.
